paite: Ka khain ka hinna a chimtaka; ka utdandanin ka phun ding hi: ka kha thangpaihnain ka gen ding.
english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

paite: Pathian kiangah, Honmohpaih ken; bangdia honkinakpih na hia hontheisak in, ka chi ding hi.
english: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

paite: Na nuaisiah nang adia hoih ahi maw, na khutte thilhih na muhsita, giloute thugen tunga na maitai?
english: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

paite: Sa mitte nei na hi hia, ahihkeileh mihing muh banga mu na hi hia?
english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

paite: Na nite mihing nite bang hia, ahihkeileh na kumte mihing kumte bang,
english: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

paite: Ka thulimlouhna na kana, ka khelhna na nungdelha,
english: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

paite: Ka gilou kei chih na theih nakpia, na khuta kipan hon suaktasak ding a omlouh?
english: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

paite: Na khutten a honsek un a honbawl kimvel sipsipa; tun kiheiin non hihse dia hia?
english: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

paite: Theigige in, ka honngen ahi, tungman banga na honmek dan; leivui hontun nawn ding na hi hia?
english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

paite: Nawitui bangin na honsung khiain, nawituidat bangin na hontok kei maw?
english: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

paite: Vun leh sain na hontuama, guhte leh thagui-tein na honphan khawm hi.
english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

paite: Hinna leh deihsakna na honphala, huan na kepnain ka lungsim a hawi hi.
english: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

paite: Himahleh hiai thilte na lungtang sungah na sela; hiai bel na tup ahi chih ka thei hi:
english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

paite: Thil ka hihkhelh leh, huchiin non chiamteha, huan ka thulimlouhna akipan na honkhah kei ding hi.
english: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

paite: Ka gitlouh leh, ka tung a gik hi; ka diktat leh, huchiin leng ka lutang ka sangsak kei ding, zahlaknaa dim ngalin leh ka gimthuakna enin.
english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still shall not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

paite: Huan ka lutang a kiletsak leh, humpinelkai bangin nang non benga: huan ka tunga na lamdandan na hon ensak nawn hi.
english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

paite: Kei kalh na palaite na thaksaka, ka tunga na hehna na khangsaka; hondou ding sepaih hon thak non sawl hi.
english: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

paite: Bangdia sul akipan kei honlakhia na hia oi leh? na si taleng, kuamah muh main.
english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me forth out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

paite: Omlou mahbang bangta ding hiinga; sul akipana hana puaka omta ding hi inga.
english: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

paite: Ka nite a tom kei maw? huchi ahihleh, tawpin, honom sak maimaiin, huchia neukhaa ka lungmuan theihna dingin.
english: Aren’t my days few? Cease then. Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

paite: Ka kik nawn louhna akipana ka pai main, khomialna gam leh sihna limliap gam mahmah ah:Mialna mahbanga, mialna sahna gama: sihna limliap gam, dan himhim omlouhna, khovak khomial banga a omna mun ah.
english: before I go where I shall not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

paite: Mialna mahbanga, mialna sahna gama: sihna limliap gam, dan himhim omlouhna, khovak khomial banga a omna mun ah.
english: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
